name: Text Box 123
text:
Plan together, travel better
Itinerary, polls and trip costs in one shared app

name: Rounded Rectangle 16
text: Group trips are planned across scattered chats, links and notes. Choices get buried, itineraries go out of date, and the group can lose track of bookings and shared costs. Travelers need one clear plan that everyone can see and update.

name: Rounded Rectangle 40
text:
1. Keep dates, bookings and activities in one shared itinerary.
2. Help every traveler weigh in through group polls.
3. Record shared costs, split bills and track payments.
4. Make the latest plan easy for the whole group to find.

name: Rounded Rectangle 52
text:
1. CREATE A TRIP
Choose a destination and dates, set a group budget, and invite friends.

2. EXPLORE & SAVE
Search flights, hotels, restaurants and attractions; keep favorites for later.

3. BUILD THE ITINERARY
Add activities to a shared daily timeline. Reorder plans or move them between days.

4. DECIDE TOGETHER
Use group polls to choose hotels, activities and dining.

5. STAY ON TRACK
Keep bookings, expenses, weather and emergency details close to the plan.

name: Rounded Rectangle 55
text:
🗓  TRIP SETUP  —  Destination, dates, budget and group

🔎  EXPLORE  —  Flights, stays, restaurants and attractions

🗺  ITINERARY  —  A shared day-by-day activity plan

✨  AI ASSIST  —  Group chat turned into reviewable ideas

🗳  GROUP POLLS  —  Vote on hotels, activities and dining

💳  EXPENSES  —  Split bills, scan receipts, track payments

✈  TRAVEL DETAILS  —  Flight and hotel info kept with the plan

☀  WEATHER  —  Check conditions and adjust outdoor plans

🛟  SAFETY  —  Emergency info and shared group location

🌍  COMMUNITY  —  Browse itineraries, reviews and insurance

name: Rounded Rectangle 99
text: Plan together, travel better. Keep the itinerary, group decisions and trip costs in one place—from the first “Where should we go?” to the journey home.

name: Rounded Rectangle 105
text: One shared plan keeps the group in sync. Everyone can see what is decided, what still needs a vote, where the trip is headed and how the costs are adding up.

name: Rounded Rectangle 92
text: The group trip planning app gives friends one shared place to plan a getaway. Explore flights, hotels and activities, build a day-by-day itinerary, vote on choices, and keep travel details and shared costs together. AI planning help, weather updates, emergency information and a travel community support the group from the first idea to departure.
